note: Paired re-analysis of the October runs and the 2 November specialist runs already on disk under the ignored evaluation/runs/; no model was called. Both runs of each pair rescored with the scorers at scored_at. Primary unit (criteria): one pair per item, its repeats folded by majority, a tie counting as not passed and an item undecided (error or human) when its undecided repeats could swing the majority. Sensitivity (line_criteria): one pair per line (item and repeat). Consistency is per item in both. A pair counts only when both sides are pass or fail; units in one run only, or skipped, error, human or na on either side, are left out and counted in excluded. p is the exact two-sided McNemar test (binomial on discordant pairs); pHolm is Holm-adjusted across the seven criteria of that comparison; pHolmFamily is Holm-adjusted across every criterion of all 19 comparisons of the same unit, a sensitivity column. aOnly: passed in A, failed in B; bOnly the reverse. Query safety and privacy check only the reply in context and code arms, so they are not like for like against tools. Synthetic data only; one sample per line, no human review.
